The invention relates to a sealing device for sealing a packaging material around a filling material in order to produce portion-packed oral pouched snuff products, such as snus portions or similar oral products intended to be placed in the mouth of a user. More specifically, the sealing device is arranged to join portions of the packaging material together so that the filling material is enclosed within a pouch formed by the packaging material.

The sealing device comprises an anvil and a sonotrode. The anvil and the sonotrode are positioned opposite one another and each comprises an operation surface. The respective operation surfaces are arranged to face each other so as to define a passage or gap through which the packaging material may be fed during operation of the sealing device. In use, the packaging material, together with the filling material to be enclosed, is guided between the anvil and the sonotrode.

The operation surfaces are configured to cooperate with one another to weld a first portion of the packaging material to a second portion of the packaging material. In particular, the sonotrode may be configured to apply ultrasonic energy to the packaging material while the anvil provides a counter-surface, thereby forming a welded seal between overlapping or adjacent portions of the packaging material. This welding operation results in the packaging material being sealed around the filling material, thereby forming individual portion-packed oral pouched snuff products.

At least one of the operation surfaces of the anvil and the sonotrode comprises two welding surfaces. These two welding surfaces have different extension plane orientations, meaning that the surfaces are not arranged in the same plane but instead extend at different angles or inclinations relative to one another. The differently oriented welding surfaces may thereby enable the formation of welds in different directions or along differently oriented parts of the pouch, improving the sealing geometry and facilitating reliable formation of the individual pouched products.

A cutting edge is provided in association with the two welding surfaces. The cutting edge partly delimits the two welding surfaces and separates them from one another. The cutting edge extends along both welding surfaces, such that it is positioned between or adjacent to the differently oriented welding regions. During operation, the cutting edge may assist in separating individual pouched products from a continuous web or strip of packaging material, while the welding surfaces form sealed portions of the pouch. In this way, the sealing device is capable of both sealing and facilitating cutting of the packaging material in an efficient and controlled manner during manufacture of portion-packed oral pouched snuff products.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to the manufacture of portion-packed oral pouched snuff products, such as snus portions, nicotine pouches or similar oral products enclosed in a porous pouch material. More particularly, the invention concerns a sealing device and a method for sealing and cutting packaging material during the continuous production of individual pouched portions.

In the production of pouched oral products, a web or tube of packaging material is typically filled with portions of product and then sealed at predetermined intervals to form individual pouches. The packaging material is commonly a permeable, nonwoven or paper-like material that allows saliva to pass through the pouch during use while retaining the product inside. For efficient high-speed manufacture, the packaging material must be reliably sealed and separated into individual portions without damaging the pouch, contaminating the product, or creating weak seals that may open during handling or use.

The invention addresses this need by providing a sealing device comprising an anvil and a sonotrode arranged opposite one another. The packaging material is guided between the anvil and the sonotrode, and opposing portions of the packaging material are welded together as the material passes through the device. In preferred embodiments, the welding is performed by ultrasonic energy supplied through the sonotrode, while the anvil provides a counter-surface against which the packaging material is pressed. The interaction between the sonotrode and the anvil creates localized heat and pressure, thereby forming a weld between the overlapping portions of the pouch material.

A key feature of the invention is that the sealing device includes operation surfaces having welding planes that are oriented differently from one another and are separated by a cutting edge. The differently oriented welding planes define separate sealing regions on opposite sides of the cutting edge. As the packaging material passes between the anvil and the sonotrode, the device can therefore form welds in the material while also cutting or severing the material along a defined line. In this way, welding and cutting are integrated into a single operation.

The cutting edge is positioned between the welding planes so that the packaging material is cut at or near the area where adjacent pouch portions are sealed. This arrangement makes it possible to create a sealed end of one pouch and a sealed end of the next pouch while simultaneously separating the two pouches from one another. The differently oriented welding planes may be arranged so that the welded regions are formed at angles relative to each other, relative to the direction of travel of the packaging material, or relative to the cutting edge. This configuration improves control over the seal geometry and helps ensure that the cut is made accurately between sealed regions.

In one embodiment, the anvil includes the cutting edge and one or more welding surfaces positioned on either side of the cutting edge. The sonotrode has corresponding operation surfaces that cooperate with the anvil surfaces to press and ultrasonically weld the packaging material. In another embodiment, the cutting edge may be provided on the sonotrode, while the anvil provides corresponding support surfaces. The surfaces may be shaped so that the welding planes are inclined, stepped, angled, curved or otherwise oriented differently to achieve the desired sealing and cutting effect.

During operation, filled packaging material is advanced between the sonotrode and the anvil. When a sealing and cutting position is reached, the sonotrode and anvil cooperate to compress the material. Ultrasonic vibration is applied, causing the opposing portions of packaging material to bond to each other along the welding planes. At substantially the same time, the cutting edge penetrates, weakens or severs the material between the welded regions. The result is a series of individual sealed pouch portions, each containing a predetermined amount of oral snuff or similar product.

The invention provides several manufacturing advantages. By combining welding and cutting in one device, the number of separate processing stations can be reduced. This simplifies the production equipment, shortens the manufacturing cycle, and improves production efficiency. The integrated operation also improves positional accuracy because the cut is made in a fixed relationship to the welds. This can reduce waste, improve pouch appearance, and lower the risk of incomplete sealing or accidental opening of the pouch.

The use of differently oriented welding planes separated by a cutting edge also contributes to reliable pouch formation. The geometry of the operation surfaces allows welding energy and mechanical pressure to be distributed in a controlled manner around the cutting zone. This helps produce strong seals while avoiding excessive compression or tearing of the packaging material. The arrangement is especially suitable for delicate porous pouch materials used in oral pouched snuff products, where both seal strength and product comfort are important.

Accordingly, the invention provides a sealing and cutting device for packaging material for portion-packed oral pouched snuff products, comprising an anvil and a sonotrode arranged to weld opposing portions of packaging material passing between them, wherein operation surfaces of the device define differently oriented welding planes separated by a cutting edge. The invention further provides a method of producing pouched snuff portions in which packaging material is welded and cut in an integrated step using such a device. This enables efficient, accurate and reliable manufacture of individual oral pouch products.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

“The” may be one of the smallest words in the English language, but it plays a very important role. It is called the definite article, and we use it when we are talking about something specific or already known. For example, “a book” could mean any book, but “the book” means a particular book that both the speaker and listener understand.

The word “the” helps make communication clearer. It points to people, places, objects, and ideas in a precise way. We say “the sun” because there is only one sun in our sky, and “the door” when we know which door is being discussed. Without “the,” many sentences would feel incomplete or confusing.

Although it is short and simple, “the” is one of the most common words in English. It appears in conversations, books, articles, songs, and speeches. Its importance shows that even the smallest words can have a big impact on meaning.

In the end, “the” is more than just a tiny word. It is a tool that brings clarity, focus, and structure to language.

## Summary of the Invention

The present disclosure relates to the manufacture of portion-packed oral pouched snuff products, such as snus pouches, nicotine pouches, or other oral pouch products comprising a filling material enclosed in a pouch material. More particularly, the disclosure relates to a device, an arrangement, and a method for forming sealed pouch portions by use of a sealing device having opposed operation surfaces configured to cooperate with one another to seal a pouch material enclosing a portion of filling material.

According to a first aspect, there is provided a device for manufacturing portion-packed oral pouched snuff products. The device comprises a sealing device having a first operation surface and a second operation surface arranged opposite the first operation surface. The first and second operation surfaces are configured to receive a pouch material between them and to cooperate to form at least one seal in the pouch material. The operation surfaces may be arranged to apply pressure, heat, ultrasonic energy, mechanical compression, or any combination thereof to the pouch material so as to join overlapping or adjacent regions of the pouch material and thereby enclose a portion of oral snuff material within a pouch.

In some embodiments, at least one of the first and second operation surfaces is movable relative to the other operation surface between an open position, in which pouch material and filling material may be advanced or positioned between the operation surfaces, and a sealing position, in which the operation surfaces act on the pouch material to produce a sealed region. The opposed arrangement of the operation surfaces enables controlled sealing of the pouch material while reducing undesired displacement of the filling material and improving the dimensional consistency of the finished pouch product.

In certain embodiments, the first operation surface comprises one or more sealing formations, such as ribs, protrusions, lands, patterned areas, or sealing contours, and the second operation surface comprises a corresponding counter-surface. The sealing formations may define a transverse seal, a longitudinal seal, an end seal, a side seal, a separation seal, or a combination thereof. The operation surfaces may be configured to form a seal pattern corresponding to the desired shape and size of an individual oral pouch product.

According to some embodiments, the sealing device is configured to produce a seal while a web or strip of pouch material is advanced through the device. The pouch material may be supplied as a continuous web, folded web, tube, or paired webs. A portioning device may deposit discrete portions of filling material onto or into the pouch material upstream of the sealing device. The sealing device may then seal the pouch material around each portion of filling material to form individual sealed pouch portions or a connected series of pouch portions that may subsequently be separated.

According to a second aspect, there is provided an arrangement for manufacturing portion-packed oral pouched snuff products. The arrangement comprises a supply of pouch material, a portioning unit configured to supply portions of oral snuff material to the pouch material, and a sealing device comprising opposed first and second operation surfaces configured to seal the pouch material around the portions. The arrangement may further comprise a transport device configured to move the pouch material along a transport direction through the arrangement, a cutting or separating device configured to separate individual pouch products, and a control unit configured to coordinate operation of the portioning unit, the transport device, and the sealing device.

In one embodiment, the opposed operation surfaces are arranged on respective sealing jaws, rollers, drums, belts, plates, anvils, or combinations thereof. The operation surfaces may be substantially planar, curved, cylindrical, or profiled. In another embodiment, the operation surfaces are provided on rotatable members configured to rotate in opposite directions so that the pouch material is sealed in a nip formed between the opposed operation surfaces. Such an arrangement may allow continuous or semi-continuous manufacture of oral pouched snuff products at high production rates.

In some embodiments, one of the opposed operation surfaces comprises an active sealing surface and the other operation surface comprises a support or anvil surface. The active sealing surface may include a heating element, an ultrasonic sonotrode, an induction element, a radio-frequency sealing element, or a mechanically actuated sealing member. The support surface may be resilient, compliant, patterned, cooled, heated, or otherwise adapted to cooperate with the active sealing surface to form a reliable seal without damaging the pouch material or adversely affecting the filling material.

According to a third aspect, there is provided a method for manufacturing portion-packed oral pouched snuff products. The method comprises supplying a pouch material, supplying a portion of oral snuff material to the pouch material, positioning the pouch material and the portion of oral snuff material between opposed first and second operation surfaces of a sealing device, and operating the sealing device such that the opposed operation surfaces cooperate to seal the pouch material around the portion of oral snuff material. The method may further comprise advancing the sealed pouch material to a cutting or separating station and separating individual portion-packed oral pouched snuff products.

In some embodiments, the method comprises forming a continuous tube or channel of pouch material, introducing portions of filling material into the tube or channel, and forming transverse seals between consecutive portions by pressing the pouch material between the opposed operation surfaces. In other embodiments, the method comprises placing filling material on a first web of pouch material, covering the filling material with a second web or folded portion of the pouch material, and sealing the webs or web portions together by means of the opposed operation surfaces.

The opposed operation surfaces may be controlled to define one or more sealing parameters, including sealing pressure, sealing temperature, ultrasonic amplitude, sealing time, dwell time, nip force, relative speed, or gap distance. By controlling one or more of these parameters, the sealing device may provide repeatable seals while limiting compression of the filling material. The device, arrangement, and method may thereby improve product quality, reduce leakage of filling material, reduce pouch material damage, and provide uniform appearance and tactile properties of the portion-packed oral pouched snuff products.

In some embodiments, the sealing device is configured to form a seal in a region of the pouch material substantially free from filling material. The arrangement may include a displacement, guiding, or compacting element configured to position or retain the filling material away from the intended sealing region before or during sealing. Alternatively or additionally, the opposed operation surfaces may be shaped to create a compression zone that moves filling material away from the sealing region as the seal is formed.

The pouch material may comprise a nonwoven material, woven material, cellulose-based material, polymer-containing material, heat-sealable material, biodegradable material, or any other material suitable for oral use. The filling material may comprise tobacco-containing snuff, tobacco-free nicotine composition, plant fiber material, flavorants, pH adjusters, humectants, salts, binders, or combinations thereof. The sealing may be achieved without the use of added adhesive, or with the aid of an adhesive or bonding agent where appropriate.

The disclosed device, arrangement, and method provide a robust and controllable manner of producing portion-packed oral pouched snuff products. By providing opposed operation surfaces in the sealing device, the pouch material can be sealed with improved precision and repeatability. The configuration may be adapted for intermittent operation, continuous operation, or indexed production, and may be implemented in new production lines or retrofitted into existing manufacturing equipment for oral pouch products.

counterfactuals.output:
Below is a patent claim-style formulation for an invention relating to sealing packaging material enclosing snuff filling material, including an anvil, sonotrode, welding surfaces, cutting edge, manufacturing arrangement, and method.

---

## Claim 1 — Sealing and Cutting Device

1. **A sealing and cutting device** for forming sealed portions of packaging material enclosing snuff filling material, the device comprising:  
   an **anvil** having an anvil welding surface;  
   a **sonotrode** arranged opposite the anvil and having a sonotrode welding surface configured to cooperate with the anvil welding surface for ultrasonic welding of overlapping portions of the packaging material; and  
   a **cutting edge** arranged in association with at least one of the anvil and the sonotrode,  
   wherein the anvil welding surface and the sonotrode welding surface are configured to compress and ultrasonically weld the packaging material in a sealing region while the cutting edge is configured to sever the packaging material in or adjacent to the sealing region, thereby forming a sealed package portion containing the snuff filling material.

---

## Claim 2 — Cutting Edge Integrated With Anvil

2. The sealing and cutting device according to claim 1, wherein the cutting edge is provided on the anvil and projects from or is positioned adjacent to the anvil welding surface.

---

## Claim 3 — Cutting Edge Integrated With Sonotrode

3. The sealing and cutting device according to claim 1, wherein the cutting edge is provided on the sonotrode and projects from or is positioned adjacent to the sonotrode welding surface.

---

## Claim 4 — Cutting Edge Between Welding Surfaces

4. The sealing and cutting device according to any preceding claim, wherein the cutting edge is arranged between two welding surface portions such that the packaging material is welded on both sides of a cut line.

---

## Claim 5 — Transverse Sealing of a Continuous Web

5. The sealing and cutting device according to any preceding claim, wherein the anvil welding surface and the sonotrode welding surface are elongated in a direction transverse to a feeding direction of a continuous tube or web of packaging material containing spaced portions of snuff filling material.

---

## Claim 6 — Patterned Welding Surface

6. The sealing and cutting device according to any preceding claim, wherein at least one of the anvil welding surface and the sonotrode welding surface comprises a patterned, ribbed, knurled, serrated, or textured surface configured to concentrate ultrasonic energy in the packaging material during welding.

---

## Claim 7 — Recess for Cutting Edge

7. The sealing and cutting device according to any preceding claim, wherein the cutting edge cooperates with a recess, counter-edge, groove, or clearance portion formed in the opposing one of the anvil and the sonotrode.

---

## Claim 8 — Controlled Cutting Depth

8. The sealing and cutting device according to any preceding claim, wherein the cutting edge is dimensioned to cut through the packaging material without substantially disturbing the snuff filling material contained in the package portion.

---

## Claim 9 — Simultaneous Welding and Cutting

9. The sealing and cutting device according to any preceding claim, wherein the device is configured to perform welding and cutting during a single compression cycle between the anvil and the sonotrode.

---

## Claim 10 — Sequential Welding and Cutting

10. The sealing and cutting device according to any of claims 1 to 8, wherein the device is configured to weld the packaging material and subsequently cut the packaging material during the same operating stroke or during sequential operating strokes.

---

## Claim 11 — Packaging Material

11. The sealing and cutting device according to any preceding claim, wherein the packaging material comprises a porous, fibrous, nonwoven, paper-based, cellulose-based, or heat-sealable material suitable for enclosing oral snuff or smokeless tobacco filling material.

---

## Claim 12 — Snuff Filling Material

12. The sealing and cutting device according to any preceding claim, wherein the snuff filling material comprises moist snuff, dry snuff, tobacco-containing snuff, tobacco-free snuff, nicotine-containing material, plant-fiber filling material, or a combination thereof.

---

## Claim 13 — Manufacturing Arrangement

13. **A manufacturing arrangement** for producing sealed snuff packages, the arrangement comprising:  
   a feed device configured to feed packaging material along a feed path;  
   a filling device configured to supply portions of snuff filling material to the packaging material;  
   a forming device configured to form the packaging material around the snuff filling material; and  
   a sealing and cutting device according to any of claims 1 to 12 arranged downstream of the filling device,  
   wherein the sealing and cutting device is configured to ultrasonically seal and cut the packaging material to form individual sealed snuff packages.

---

## Claim 14 — Continuous Pouch Production

14. The manufacturing arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the feed device is configured to feed a continuous strip or tube of packaging material, and wherein the sealing and cutting device is configured to form transverse seals between successive portions of snuff filling material.

---

## Claim 15 — Synchronization

15. The manufacturing arrangement according to claim 13 or 14, further comprising a control unit configured to synchronize feeding of the packaging material, supply of the snuff filling material, ultrasonic activation of the sonotrode, movement of the anvil and sonotrode relative to each other, and cutting by the cutting edge.

---

## Claim 16 — Rotary or Reciprocating Operation

16. The manufacturing arrangement according to any of claims 13 to 15, wherein the anvil and sonotrode are arranged for rotary operation, reciprocating operation, or intermittent pressing operation.

---

## Claim 17 — Method of Manufacturing Sealed Snuff Packages

17. **A method of manufacturing sealed snuff packages**, comprising:  
   feeding packaging material along a feed path;  
   placing snuff filling material on or within the packaging material;  
   arranging overlapping portions of the packaging material between an anvil and a sonotrode;  
   pressing the packaging material between an anvil welding surface of the anvil and a sonotrode welding surface of the sonotrode;  
   ultrasonically energizing the sonotrode to weld the overlapping portions of the packaging material and form a seal; and  
   cutting the packaging material with a cutting edge arranged in association with at least one of the anvil and the sonotrode to separate a sealed package portion containing the snuff filling material.

---

## Claim 18 — Method With Simultaneous Welding and Cutting

18. The method according to claim 17, wherein welding and cutting are performed substantially simultaneously during a single pressing operation between the anvil and the sonotrode.

---

## Claim 19 — Method With Welds on Both Sides of Cut

19. The method according to claim 17 or 18, wherein the packaging material is welded in two sealing regions located on opposite sides of a cutting line before or during cutting along the cutting line.

---

## Claim 20 — Method for Individual Portions

20. The method according to any of claims 17 to 19, wherein the method forms individual oral snuff pouches from a continuous web or tube of packaging material containing discrete portions of snuff filling material.

---

## Claim 21 — Independent Apparatus Claim With Functional Emphasis

21. **An apparatus for sealing packaging material enclosing snuff filling material**, comprising:  
   an anvil including a first welding surface;  
   an ultrasonic sonotrode including a second welding surface facing the first welding surface;  
   a drive arrangement configured to move the anvil and the sonotrode relative to one another so as to compress packaging material therebetween; and  
   a cutting edge positioned relative to the first and second welding surfaces so as to cut the packaging material at a predetermined cutting location,  
   wherein the first and second welding surfaces are configured to form an ultrasonic weld in the packaging material at a location adjacent to the predetermined cutting location, and wherein the cutting edge is configured to separate a sealed package containing snuff filling material from a remainder of the packaging material.

---

## Claim 22 — Use Claim

22. **Use of** a sealing and cutting device according to any of claims 1 to 12 for producing sealed pouches containing snuff filling material by ultrasonic welding and cutting of packaging material.

---

This wording is drafted in a patent-claim style and can be adapted to emphasize either the device, the manufacturing line, or the method of producing sealed snuff portions.
